riskDescription.context: Scope and delivery expectations are evolving without a formally approved SOW or CR, and support has been extended at no cost until September 2026 without formal contractual clarity. Cost dimension is Red in EMS.
riskDescription.condition: Revenue leakage may continue as effort is expended without clear commercial coverage, and future funding may remain uncertain beyond the extension period.
riskDescription.consequence: Margin erosion could accelerate, and the business may be unable to recover costs or secure additional revenue for expanded scope.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal CR approval process with written scope documentation, impact assessment, and stakeholder sign-off before any additional work commences.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon September 2026 deadline without approved SOW, stop all undefined scope work immediately and escalate to portfolio leadership within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R832 (Major/Very Likely/High/Identified) corroborated by ALT noting original SOW/CR lacked commercials and ongoing CR discussions. Cost RAG is Red. Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: Original SOW and subsequent CR lacked defined end dates, scope boundaries, and commercials. Scope dimension is Red in EMS, and ALT reports challenges in clarity of scope and features to be implemented in Verify application.
riskDescription.condition: Scope may continue to expand without formal boundaries or change control, leading to uncontrolled effort consumption and delivery ambiguity.
riskDescription.consequence: Project timeline and resource utilization could remain unpredictable, and client expectations may diverge from delivery capacity.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement change control board with formal scope baseline, documented acceptance criteria, and weekly scope variance tracking to prevent unauthorized expansion.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once scope deviation exceeds 15% of baseline effort, freeze new requests and escalate to executive sponsors for rebaselining within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risks R832 and R833 (Major/Very Likely/High/Identified) both cite evolving scope without approved SOW/CR. ALT independently confirms scope clarity challenges. Scope RAG is Red. Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: IBM Verify product has ongoing limitations and feature gaps, and the project relies on IBM for product fixes. ALT notes Verify implementation encountered feature gaps and dependency-related delays due to ongoing alignment between IBM and Red Hat.
riskDescription.condition: Critical product features may remain unavailable or delayed, blocking application onboarding and integration work.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines could slip further, and business benefits realization may be postponed, weakening client confidence.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly IBM fix tracking with SLA commitments, prioritize critical-path functionality, and maintain documented dependency log for all product gaps.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon IBM fix delay exceeding two weeks for critical features, activate phased delivery plan and escalate to IBM executive sponsors immediately.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R831 (Major/Very Likely/High/Identified) cites IBM Verify product limitations. ALT independently confirms feature gaps and dependency delays. Timeline RAG is Red. Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: Following the Red Hat-IBM organizational transition starting October 1, 2026, limited stakeholder availability for key decisions is creating uncertainty. EMS risk R833 and ALT both document the merger.
riskDescription.condition: Decision-making velocity may decline as stakeholders navigate the organizational integration, delaying approvals, scope clarifications, and governance alignment.
riskDescription.consequence: Project continuity and delivery predictability could weaken, and unresolved decisions may accumulate, raising execution risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define delegation of authority framework with scheduled bi-weekly decision checkpoints and clear escalation paths for time-sensitive approvals during merger transition.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When decision approval exceeds five business days, escalate to alternate stakeholder per delegation matrix and notify executive sponsors within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R833 (Major/Very Likely/High/Identified) cites limited stakeholder availability post-merger. ALT confirms RedHat IT and Security operations merging with IBM from Oct 1, 2026. Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: EMS observation OBS6482 (Open, aging 29 days) recommends finalizing the CR strategy and documenting the commercial approach, and continuing direct engagement with customer leadership to establish clarity on onboarding plans. No formal SOW/CR is yet approved.
riskDescription.condition: Governance alignment may remain weak, and leadership visibility into contract status, onboarding progress, and customer dependencies may be insufficient to drive timely decisions.
riskDescription.consequence: Strategic misalignment could persist, and the project may lack the executive sponsorship needed to resolve commercial and scope uncertainties.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Restore weekly status reporting to executive sponsors covering contract status, onboarding progress, and customer dependencies with documented action items and owners.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If governance review cycle misses two consecutive weeks, activate direct customer leadership engagement and communicate impact to portfolio leadership immediately.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS observation OBS6482 (Process/Documentation, aging 29 days) calls for stronger governance and weekly status reporting. ALT confirms ongoing CR and SOW discussions. Combined signal from EMS and ALT.

riskDescription.context: Three additional applications have been identified for onboarding, and the engagement is expected to continue for an additional three months. ALT notes team will continue with same team strength during the organizational merger.
riskDescription.condition: Current resource capacity may become insufficient to absorb the additional onboarding workload while maintaining delivery velocity on existing scope.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint throughput could decline, and quality or timeline commitments may be at risk if capacity is not scaled to match expanded demand.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct capacity assessment against three additional applications, define workload redistribution plan, and identify cross-training opportunities to build backup coverage.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If sprint velocity drops below 80% for two consecutive sprints, engage contractor resources and notify customer of timeline impact within one week.
risks.reasoning: EMS observation OBS6481 notes 3 additional applications identified for onboarding and 3-month extension. ALT confirms team strength maintained. Talent RAG is Green, but workload expansion signal exists. Single-source basis for capacity risk.

riskDescription.context: The project is in Integration stage and relies on IBM for product fixes and alignment on scope and rollout timelines. ALT notes ongoing alignment between IBM and Red Hat on rollout timelines.
riskDescription.condition: Deployment readiness may be delayed if IBM product fixes or rollout approvals are not delivered on schedule, or if integration dependencies remain unresolved.
riskDescription.consequence: Go-live dates could slip, and production stability may be compromised if integration issues surface late in the cycle.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish integration dependency log with IBM, conduct weekly rollout alignment reviews, and prioritize critical-path functionality to protect production rollout schedule.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon integration delay exceeding one week, activate phased go-live plan and escalate to project manager for rebaselining decision within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: EMS risk R833 cites reliance on IBM for product fixes. ALT confirms ongoing alignment on rollout timelines. Quality RAG is Green, but deployment dependency signal exists. Timeline RAG is Red. Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: Lack of application onboarding has contributed to prolonged delivery timelines and delayed realization of business benefits, per EMS risk R831. Three additional applications have now been identified for onboarding.
riskDescription.condition: Customer adoption velocity may remain low if onboarding processes are not streamlined or if business readiness activities lag behind technical delivery.
riskDescription.consequence: Client satisfaction could decline, and the business case for the IGA/IAM platform may weaken if usage does not ramp up as planned.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement streamlined onboarding process with documented training, business acceptance criteria, and weekly adoption tracking for the three identified applications.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If onboarding completion rate falls below 50% by mid-quarter, engage customer leadership to address business readiness gaps and adjust delivery phasing.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R831 (Major/Very Likely/High/Identified) cites lack of application onboarding and delayed business benefits. EMS observation OBS6481 notes 3 additional applications identified. CSAT RAG is Green, but adoption signal exists. Target Date: 2026-12-31.
